corrections.reasonJa: LEV24:11 source says “of the tribe of Dan”; it identifies Shelomith’s tribal affiliation, not the patriarch Dan. Root clarification permits an existing-ID collective card, explicitly avoiding an invented person.
corrections.sourceText: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
corrections.wikipediaRead: Article identifies Tribe of Dan as one of the twelve tribes of Israel; collective match only, not individual Dan.

corrections.reasonJa: Root confirmed the publisher’s footnote maps the witness’s ROM14:24–26 doxology to conventional ROM16:25–27. Added ROM16:25 as a related (not directly named) God occurrence; retained source URL ROM14:24 and documented mapping note.
corrections.identityBasisJa: The “him” in 16:25 is continued by “the eternal God” at 16:26 and “the only wise God” at 16:27 in the same doxology; this is contextual linkage, not explicit naming at 16:25.

corrections.reasonJa: Corrected an accidental non-Japanese string to the Japanese rendering エルザパン for WEB spelling Elzaphan. The Hebrew name in the WEB verse and source ID are unchanged.
WEB spells the name Elzaphan; the Japanese display was refined to the recognizable phonetic rendering エルザファン.
ROM5:12は「一人の人」とだけ記すため、初出時の表示名・常時表示文・出典を同節の範囲に改めた。固有名Adam、死がアダムからモーセまで支配したこと、来るべき方の前触れという後続情報は5:14の名前ゲートとfactに分離。5:12はrelated、5:14はdirectとして記録。
corrections.sourceText: ROM5:12: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned. ROM5:14: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

corrections.reasonJa: ROM16:7の“my fellow prisoners”は「共に囚われた仲間」であり、「同労者」ではない。初出節の範囲内に役割を修正し、後代伝承に触れる編集注は同名混同でないためidentityNoteから外した。
corrections.sourceText: ROM 16:7: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

corrections.reasonJa: ROM1:3はイエスが肉によればダビデの子孫であると述べる。ダビデを引用句の話者として扱うのは4:6と11:9なので、その後続情報は既存のknownBy factに分け、subtitle/historicalRoleを1:3の根拠に限定した。
corrections.sourceText:
ROM 1:3: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
ROM 4:6: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:
ROM 11:9: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

corrections.reasonJa: ROM5:5では聖霊が与えられ、神の愛が心に注がれると述べる。summaryとhistoricalRoleから8章以降の内住・助け等を除き、全19件の後続出現を各節のsourceId付きknownBy factへ分離した。
corrections.sourceText:
ROM 5:5: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
ROM 8:1: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
ROM 8:2: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
ROM 8:4: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
ROM 8:5: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
ROM 8:9: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
ROM 8:11: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
ROM 8:13: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
ROM 8:14: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
ROM 8:15: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
ROM 8:16: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
ROM 8:23: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
ROM 8:26: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
ROM 8:27: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
ROM 9:1: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
ROM 14:17: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
ROM 15:13: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
ROM 15:16: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
ROM 15:19: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;
ROM 15:30: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

corrections.reasonJa: イザヤの名はローマ9:27に初出する。9:29、10:16、10:20、15:12の後続引用は各節の初出factと同節primary sourceへ移し、subtitle/summary/roleを9:27の内容に限定した。
corrections.sourceText:
ROM 9:27: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
ROM 9:29: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
ROM 10:16: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
ROM 10:20: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
ROM 15:12: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

corrections.reasonJa: 固定WEBレビ記10:4で父名Uzzielを確認し、subtitleの父名を日本語読者向け表記「ウジエル」に統一した。
corrections.sourceText: LEV10:4: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”

corrections.reasonJa: ローマ16:5にあるAchaiaの記述と、カルタゴのエパネトに関する別資料との同一性は本文だけでは確認できない。編集作業の「候補」「採用」という説明を外し、同名人物の区別に必要な読者向け注意にした。
corrections.sourceText: ROM 16:5: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

corrections.reasonJa: ローマ9:13はヤコブとエサウを並べて引用するが兄弟関係や族長という説明はこの書では述べない。常時表示のsubtitle/roleを同節で確かめられる言及に限定した。
corrections.sourceText: ROM 9:13: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

corrections.sourceText: ROM 1:1: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

corrections.reasonJa: ローマ9:17は個人名でなくPharaohという王の称号を引用する。subtitle/roleをこの節の範囲にし、個人特定ができないという重複したidentityNoteは除去した。identityType=office-titleで称号表示する既存設定は保持し、kind分類は現行カード仕様が必要とするため変更していない。
corrections.sourceText: ROM 9:17: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

corrections.reasonJa: ローマ16:22はテルティオがこの手紙を書いていると述べる。Wikipedia見出しへの編集メモと本文に書かれていない内容の説明を常時表示欄から外し、手紙内の役割に限定した。
corrections.sourceText: ROM 16:22: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

corrections.reasonJa: ローマ9:17はPharaohという称号で王を名指すが、固有名は示さない。王は民族集団ではないためkindをpersonにし、カードの称号表示を担うidentityType=office-titleを保持した。既存IDを維持し、個人名は創作していない。
